مَغْزَاةٌ : see غَزْوَةٌ, in three places. ―
-b2- Also A place of غَزْو [meaning making a warring, or warring and plundering, expedition]: pl. مَغَازٍ. (TA.) ―
-b3- And المَغَازِى signifies also The memorable deeds of the غُزَاة [meaning those who engage in warring, or warring and plundering, expeditions, pl. of غَازٍ]: (K, TA:) in which sense, some say, it has no sing., but others say that its sing. is مَغْزَاةٌ or ↓ مَغْزًى . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
